page.overview:
Who is Bill Aston?

William "Bill" Aston was a British driver, motorcycle racer and test pilot. After World War II he turned to four wheel racing, and in 1951 he set a world speed record at Montlhéry in a 500cc with a V-twin JAP engine.

In 1952, he teamed up with Archie Butterworth to create the . The under-funded car ran four times, with the 52-year-old Aston entering three Grands Prix, only making the start at the Nürburgring.

Aston raced a Jaguar and a Mini into his 60s before retiring.
